title: WS2812 strip on GPIO 2
about: pico-examples ws2812: side-set drives the data line, 10 SM clocks per bit at 800 kHz; a host script sends 8 LEDs per frame (a moving rainbow) with the 50 us reset between frames.
reference: Wokwi Pi Pico ws2812 example (NeoPixel ring): same bit timing, T1 3 / T2 3 / T3 4.
